usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It compiles with `wj run --compiled` and gave the right output on my test input.

I ran it on five lines: an empty line, `,`, `"he said ""hi""",1`, `"x,y",z` and `"a"`. Those cover your Example 2 and the quoted-comma case from Example 1. Each came out as expected, for example `1: []` for the empty line and `2: [he said "hi"]|[1]`.
